name: Jaunter’s Juxtaposition
body:
Prerequisite(s): Rogue 10, Jaunter’s Hop, worship a deity that grants the Trickery and Travel domains (or their subdomains)

Benefit(s): As a move action the rogue can expend 2 motes of movement to cast hostile juxtaposition as a spell-like ability. If the rogue is at least 14th level she cane expend 3 motes of movement and this can function as greater hostile juxtaposition.
